findings.evidence: In the same file, `extendByZeroLinearMap_apply` (l.182), `tsupport_extendByZero` (l.107), `restrict_extendByZero` (l.189) and `extendByZero_restrict` (l.228) are all `@[simp]`; `restrictLinearMap_apply` in Module.lean:279 is `@[simp] ... := (rfl)`.
findings.fix: Tag these `@[simp]`. Where possible, state the `_val` lemmas with `:= (rfl)` like `extendByZeroLinearMap_apply`.
findings.issue: New algebraic laws are untagged: `extendByZeroToOpenLinearMap_val`, `tsupport_extendByZeroToOpenLinearMap`, `extendByZeroToOpenLinearMap_refl`, `extendByZero_extendByZeroToOpenLinearMap`, `extendByZeroToOpenLinearMap_comp`, `restrictUnivLinearMap_val`. Simp therefore cannot evaluate the new maps, although it can evaluate the existing ones.

findings.evidence: In this file, `@[simp]` appears only on the `_apply*` lemmas and `restrictDualCLM_apply`/`restrictDualToOpenCLM_apply`; all the laws listed above have no attribute.
findings.fix: Tag the identity, composition, support and delta normal-form laws `@[simp]`. Use `@[simp]` on the applied forms of `_comp` (e.g. `extendByZeroToOpenCLM h' (extendByZeroToOpenCLM h s) = ...`) so they fire under application.
findings.issue: Native rewrite laws are untagged: `tsupport_extendByZeroCLM`, `extendByZeroCLM_localizeCLM`, `restrictDualCLM_delta_of_notMem`/`_of_mem`, `extendByZeroToOpenCLM_refl`/`_comp`, `extendByZeroCLM_extendByZeroToOpenCLM`, `tsupport_extendByZeroToOpenCLM`, `restrictDualToOpenCLM_refl`/`_comp`/`_restrictDualCLM`, `univCLE_toContinuousLinearMap`. Simp cannot normalize the composites these lemmas describe.

findings.evidence: `extendByZeroCLM_apply_of_notMem` and `extendByZeroCLM_apply_of_mem` are both `@[simp]`; for `extendByZeroToOpenCLM`, only `extendByZeroToOpenCLM_apply_of_mem` is.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] extendByZeroToOpenCLM_apply_of_notMem (x : D) (hx : (x : M) ∉ U) : ... = 0`, or make `extendByZeroToOpenCLM_apply` the simp rule and drop the redundant `_of_mem` tag.
findings.issue: `extendByZeroToOpenCLM` has a simp rule only for points of the smaller open (`_apply_of_mem`). The general `extendByZeroToOpenCLM_apply` is not simp and there is no `_apply_of_notMem`, so simp cannot evaluate at points of `D \ U`. `extendByZeroCLM` has both `_of_mem` and `_of_notMem`.

findings.evidence: `univCLE` sets `invFun := restrictUnivCLM`; the only identification lemma is `univCLE_toContinuousLinearMap` for the forward direction.
findings.fix: Add `univCLE_symm_toContinuousLinearMap : (univCLE).symm.toContinuousLinearMap = restrictUnivCLM` (proved by `(rfl)`), parallel to the forward lemma.
findings.issue: `restrictUnivCLM` and `univCLE.symm` are two public names for the same map. `univCLE_toContinuousLinearMap` identifies the forward map, but nothing identifies the inverse, so statements written with `restrictUnivCLM` and statements written with `univCLE.symm` cannot be rewritten into each other.

summary: Most new characteristic laws are untagged, unlike the existing extension-by-zero API where every such law is `@[simp]`. Intermediate extension has no simp rule for points outside the smaller open, and the inverse of `univCLE` is not linked to `restrictUnivCLM`.
